user.title: Self-hosted game servers
user.description: Steam is asked which game servers are listed at your public address. Each one found becomes a device.

data_description.public_address: Your public IPv4 address or a host name that points to it. Leave empty to detect it automatically.
data_description.local_host: The address Home Assistant uses to check each game directly, for example 192.168.1.50. Leave empty to use the public address.

init.title: Other servers
init.description: Add game servers Steam does not list, such as ones only used on your own network.

data_description.manual_servers: One per line as host:port, using the game's query port. For example 192.168.1.50:27015. If Steam also lists a server added here, it is monitored as this one.

error.invalid_servers: Each line must be host:port, for example 192.168.1.50:27015.
